sources.molar_mass: 222.0176 g/mol, the atomic mass of radon-222, its longest-lived isotope: Wang et al., The AME 2020 atomic mass evaluation (II), Chinese Physics C 45 (2021) 030003, https://doi.org/10.1088/1674-1137/abddaf. Radon has no standard atomic weight
sources.molar_heat_capacity: C_v = 3/2 R, a monatomic ideal gas. No NIST-JANAF table for radon was found. R: CODATA 2018, 8.314462618 J/(mol·K)
